bio.text: Dan Koh won the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026 for Massachusetts's 6th Congressional District, the seat held by Rep. Seth Moulton, and faces Republican Micah Quinney Jones in November.
He is a former advisor to President Joe Biden and a former chief of staff to then-Boston Mayor Marty Walsh.
The Harvard Crimson identifies him as a member of Harvard's class of 2007 (Daniel A. Koh '07).

sources.title: Dan Koh wins primary for 6th congressional district to replace Seth Moulton
